description: Set a webhook URL to get notified when new email arrives on an open-policy inbox that has no owner key. On an allowlist inbox, or any inbox with an owner key, this agent-key tool is refused; the human owner must use POST /v1/agent-mail/owner/webhook with the owner key.

secret.description: Signing secret for the X-Voidmail-Signature-256 HMAC header, at least 32 characters (server-generated if omitted)

name: voidmail_set_webhook
